title.narrative: Pakistan Swappable Battery-based Network for Promoting Electric Vehicles

description.narrative: In Pakistan, where transport contributes 43% to national GHG emissions, this project focuses on promoting swappable battery based electric three-wheelers (SE3Ws) as a solution to reduce emissions and support the country's NDC commitments of achieving 30% electric vehicles in new sales by 2030. Recognizing the unique challenges in Pakistan, such as high upfront costs and technical barriers like long charging times and range anxiety, the approach integrates a Mobility as a Service (MaaS) model using swappable battery technology to provide under 2-minute battery exchanges. This model addresses issues of inadequate charging infrastructure and makes electric three-wheelers viable through rental rather than direct sales, overcoming financial and service-related hurdles for the underprivileged populace relying on informal credit. The project aims to establish 554 swapping stations and deploy 38,725 vehicles within five years, achieving reduction in 1,525,876 tCO2 of GHG emission.
